goal: Bring the GitHub repository toward a current main branch: README.md and production code on main are old, so create a safe remote release train that updates README/code through PRs, CI and owner merge gates.
objective: On a server node, compare origin/main README.md/code with the current Kolibri Factory source-of-truth PRs and dispatcher docs. Identify why main is stale, update README and docs on a dedicated branch, prepare the code release path for ready PRs, fix small release blockers where allowed, and open/update draft PR(s). Do not push directly to main. Do not merge or mark ready without owner approval.
expected_actions: Fetch origin/main and all relevant PR heads into a clean remote worktree.
Classify which PRs are ready, blocked, docs-only, or require repair.
Update README.md on a dedicated branch so main-facing documentation reflects Mac thin-client, Control Plane, Agent Host, API-first Fabric, always-online fleet, Home UI and agent mesh.
For PR #85, respect release gate: fix only doc whitespace if needed, rerun checks, and keep merge gated by owner approval.
Do not mix Telegram, billing, Kwork/business, runner hardening and Fabric API changes into one PR unless the release plan explicitly marks them as already separated.
Open or update draft PR(s) with clear Russian/English summary, test evidence and next owner decision.
If GitHub push fails from server, classify blocker and prepare relay instructions/artifacts instead of claiming completion.
verification_commands: python3 -m py_compile ops/factory_control.py ops/agent_host.py ops/kolibri-dispatch || true
python3 -m pytest tests/test_fabric_control.py tests/test_prompt3_fabric_api_surface.py -q || classify missing tests/deps
gh pr view relevant PRs if gh is available, otherwise use git ls-remote and GitHub API/connector if available
acceptance: Remote execution happens on a server node, not Mac.
Main branch is not pushed to directly and not merged without owner approval.
README.md update branch/PR is created or a concrete blocker is reported.
Open PRs are classified in a release train matrix.
PR #85 release gate blocker is included and not ignored.
No unrelated changes are mixed into one PR.
Tests/CI evidence or exact blocker classification is recorded.
Final result includes branch/PR URL if created, tests, blockers and next owner decision.
